title: Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai
body:
Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
hawa Hai Na Ujaala Hai**2
<<MINI>>
yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
saro'n Par Qaak Girti Hai Na Takiya Na Bichona Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
1. Andhere Qaidqane Mein Sada Wehshat Barasti Hai,, (sada Wehshat Barasti Hai).
ujaala Dekhne Ke Waaste Aankhein Tarasti Hai,, (meri Aankhein Tarasti Hai).
jidhar Dekhu'n Nigaho'n Mein Andhera Hi Andhera Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jigar Mein Dard Uth-ta Hai Mai Jis Dam Saans Leti Hoon,, (mai Jis Dam Saans Leti Hoon).
sitam Ke Taziyane Har Ghadi Har Aan Sehti Hoon,, (chacha Har Aan Sehti Hoon).
gale Ki Reesma'n Se Dam Mera Zindaa'n Mein Ghut-ta Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
3. Tamache Khake Zalim Ke Mere Ruqsaar Hai Neele(mere Ruqsaar Hai Neele).
<<DIVIDER>>
sitam Se Pusht Zaqmi Hai Mere Boseeda Hai Kapde(mere Boseeda Hai Kapde).
meri Kaano'n Se Ay Baba Lahoo Shano'n Pe Behta Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
4. Aqi Sajjad Asws. Ke Pehlu Mein Mai Jaakar Baith Jaati Hoon(mai Jaakar Baith Jaati Hoon).
kabhi Madar Ke Aanchal Mein Chupi Aansoo Bahati Hoon(chupi Aansoo Bahati Hoon).
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhari Yaad Mein Bechain Mera Dil Jo Hota Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
5. Main Apne Hisse Ka Pani Bacha Rakkhi Hun Kooze Mein(bacha Rakkhi Hoon Kooze Mein).
tadapta Pyaas Ke Maare Use Dekhi Thi Jhoole Mein(use Dekhi Thi Jhoole Mein).
wo Pyasa Bezubaa'n Asghar Asws. Mera Jab Yaad Aata Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Yahan Zindaan Mein Baba Mera Dushwaar Hai Jeena(mera Dushwaar Hai Jeena).
mere Ammu Se Darya Par Mera Paigham Ye Kehna(mera Paighaam Ye Kehna).
sitamgar L.a. Seliyo'n Se Maarke Mujhko Rulata Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
7. Kabhi Fursat Mile To Haal Mera Dekhiye Aakar(ay Baba Dekhiye Aakar).
<<DIVIDER>>
andhere Qaidqane Mein Na Takiya Hai Na Hai Bsitar(na Takiya Hai Na Hai Bistar).
ghazab Ki Pyaas Hai Baba Na Pani Hai Na Khana Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
8. Sakina S.a. Ki Museebat Par Haram Aansoo Bahate Hai(haram Aansoo Bahate Hai).
jo Matamdaar Ye Rokar Tera Nauha Sunate Hai(tera Nauha Sunate Hai).
<<DIVIDER>>
qalam Ko Rokle (mazhar) Haram Mein Shor Hota Hai,, Yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai--yeh Kaisa Qaidqana Hai.
az: Shayer E Ahlebait Janab Mazhar Abidi Sahab
